title: How do I connect augo with Gemini?
seoTitle: Connect augo to Gemini | augo support
description: Step by step: add augo as a custom app in Gemini Developer Mode, sign in with your augo email, and start asking Gemini about your athletes.
summary: Gemini can now use augo's MCP server, the same one that powers the Claude and ChatGPT connector. Until augo is listed in Gemini, you add it as a custom app in Gemini Developer Mode. It takes about two minutes in a desktop browser.

body.html:
At a glance

  • Who it's for. Coaches with an augo account.
  • What you need. A personal Google account, Gemini in a desktop browser, and your augo email.
  • Setup time. About two minutes.
  • Cost. Included in augo Pro. Coaches also have access during the 14-day free trial.

Early access. Google opened Gemini to outside apps in October 2026, and augo is not listed there yet. Until it is, you connect augo through Gemini Developer Mode. Once augo is listed, you will be able to add it from Gemini's app list instead.

augo MCP server URL

You paste this once. It is the only thing that has to be exact.

https://api.augotraining.com/mcp

steps.title: Open Gemini Developer Mode
steps.html:
In a desktop browser, go to gemini.google.com/devmode, or in Gemini click Settings, then Gemini Apps Developer Mode.

If you land on the normal Gemini start page instead, Developer Mode isn't available for the account you're signed in with. See the questions below.

steps.title: Create a new app
steps.html: The Choose an app window opens. Click Create new.

media.alt: Gemini's Choose an app window with no custom MCP servers yet and a Create new button
media.caption: Click Create new.

steps.title: Paste the augo MCP server URL
steps.html: Paste the augo MCP server URL into MCP Server URL and click Next. Leave Additional settings as they are. augo doesn't need a client ID or a secret.

media.alt: The Connect to an MCP server window with https://api.augotraining.com/mcp in the MCP Server URL field
media.caption: Paste the URL, then click Next.

steps.title: Accept the warning and connect
steps.html:
Gemini shows what a custom app may do. Tick “I understand and accept the security and privacy risks of connecting this custom app” and click Connect.

Gemini shows this warning for every app Google hasn't reviewed yet, not for augo in particular. It is there because an app can read your data and act on it.

media.alt: Gemini's Connect this MCP server window for https://api.augotraining.com/mcp, with the risk checkbox ticked
media.caption: Tick the checkbox, then click Connect.

steps.title: Sign in with your augo email
steps.html:
A sign-in window opens. Enter the email you use for augo, and augo sends you a link. Open your inbox and click the link.

There is no password to type. If the link doesn't arrive within a minute, check your spam folder.

steps.title: Save the app
steps.html: In Save your custom app, keep the name Augo and click Connect. The list underneath shows the augo actions Gemini can now use.

media.alt: The Save your custom app window named Augo, listing augo actions such as list_athletes and get_coach_priorities
media.caption: Keep the name Augo and click Connect.

steps.title: Ask about your athletes
steps.html:
Write your question in the Gemini chat, for example “@Augo which of my athletes needs attention today?”.

Before Gemini sends a message, changes a workout or deletes anything in augo, it asks you to confirm.

body.html:
What to do once you are connected

Gemini can do the same things as Claude and ChatGPT with augo. See what can I do with the augo connector? for real use cases, and the example questions to get started.

faqs.question: gemini.google.com/devmode just sends me to the normal Gemini page.
faqs.answer: Developer Mode isn't available for that Google account. As of November 2026, Google Workspace accounts (a work or school address) don't get it, even when the Workspace admin has Gemini turned on. Sign in with a personal Google account instead. Your augo sign-in stays the same.

faqs.question: Why do I have to use Developer Mode?
faqs.answer: Google opened Gemini to outside apps as a preview, and new apps are listed only after Google reviews them. augo has applied. Until augo is listed, Developer Mode is how you add it yourself.

faqs.question: Can I add augo from the Gemini phone app?
faqs.answer: No. Developer Mode is only in Gemini in a desktop browser.

faqs.question: Does my athletes' data leave augo when I use Gemini?
faqs.answer: Whatever Gemini reads from augo is sent to Google to answer your question, under Google's terms and data retention. If that is not acceptable for your athletes' data, do not connect.

faqs.question: How do I disconnect augo from Gemini?
faqs.answer: Remove augo on the Connected Apps page in Gemini, or delete its link in your Google Account. Access stops straight away. Your augo account, athletes and data are not affected.
